reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (OVER-CONSTRAINED): Same bug as PRODUCT_108/135/157 (0f8f8094d28.c, Linux kmalloc). PULSE_UNINITIALIZED_VALUE on 'cache' at line 36 when LOCKDEP=true, SLOB=true — accessing kmalloc_caches[i] when kmalloc_caches is undeclared (inside #ifndef SLOB). This is the known vbdb OutOfBoundsRead/UndeclaredIdentifier bug. OVER-CONSTRAINED: Core condition is LOCKDEP=true && SLOB=true; PPC_256K_PAGES=true, SLAB=true, FORCE_MAX_ZONEORDER=false are irrelevant (SLAB=true is also contradictory with SLOB=true in Linux). Extra flags unnecessarily restrict the presence condition.
